operations.name: Ernest McQueen

expected.charges: Desertion (Vietnam era) - Marine private who walked away from his unit in November 1969 citing fears of Vietnam deployment and the moral weight of learning about the 1968 My Lai massacre.
expected.sentence:
Brief military custody following January 2006 apprehension in Fort Worth, Texas.

Verdict as recorded: No - discharged without disciplinary action, January 2006

Charges as recorded: Desertion (Vietnam era) - Marine private who walked away from his unit in November 1969 citing fears of Vietnam deployment and the moral weight of learning about the 1968 My Lai massacre. Lived under his mothers married surname (per his Social Security card) in Fort Worth, Texas for ~36 years until a former brother-in-law disclosed his whereabouts to Marine investigators.
